profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer Associate at Revature, I primarily develop ServiceNow solutions for Revature clients, utilizing skills such as System Dictionary, Notifications & Events, ACL, Roles, Server-Side scripts (Business Rules, Script Include, Data Policy, etc.), Client-Side scripting (Client Scripts and UI Policies), Service Portal, and ticketing system creation.

In addition to my role at Revature, I am also a Software Developer at Remotasks, a platform that connects freelancers with tasks that require various skills and technologies. I work on projects that involve web development, data analysis, machine learning, and computer vision, using Python, TensorFlow, OpenCV, and other tools. I enjoy coding and solving problems, and I am always eager to learn new skills and technologies.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Our main goal at Outlier is to train and produce AI models for clients in the Computational programming industry. I work on projects that involve web development, data analysis, machine learning, and computer vision, using Python, JavaScript, Java, MySQL, TensorFlow, OpenCV, and other tools.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: During my time at Revature, I primarily developed ServiceNow solutions for Revature clients, where I learned about System Dictionary, Notifications & Events, ACL, Roles, Server-Side scripts (Business Rules, Script Include, Data Policy, etc.), Client-Side scripting (Client Scripts and UI Policies), Service Portal, and ticketing system creation.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description: As a full-stack Developer of a start-up building a foundation, my job required me to support, develop, and debug web applications and their services, creating new features and enhancing existing ones. Utilizing different technology stacks for their various projects, such as TypeScript, MUI, .NET, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase, Docker, and a few more, to make the web applications fully responsive, create the best user experience, and create software solutions based on the business instructions.

positions.title: Mentor
positions.description: As a mentor, my responsibilities include resolving students' inquiries and explaining to them the skills they are being exposed to, besides helping them with their projects and guiding them to have a successful learning path and become hireable to expose them to the job market.

projects.title: GigHive
projects.description: A middle man APP for venues and musicians created from scratch, using back and front end technologies like Python, Flask, SQL, JavaScript, React and APIs. Three person production, pitched for our final project.
